name: Catch of the Day
summary: At Ghost Walker Post, Nataka Longhorn is longing for cooked fish. She praises the trolls of Shadowprey Village as the finest fish-catchers, but centaur activity keeps her from making the journey. She asks you to bring her two Bloodbelly fish.

sections.title: A Taste of the Coast
sections.body: At Ghost Walker Post, Nataka Longhorn has gone a long while without cooked fish. She trusts the trolls of Shadowprey Village to catch the finest fish, but centaur activity leaves her little time to travel. So she asks you to speak with Jinar'Zillen, the village's local fisherman, and bring back two Bloodbelly fish. They are Nataka's favorite. The road south of the post bends west toward the troll village.

faq.q: Who is looking for Bloodbelly fish?
aliases: who gives catch of the day
faq.answer: Nataka Longhorn at Ghost Walker Post in Desolace is looking for Bloodbelly fish. They are her favorite.

faq.q: Why can't Nataka Longhorn get the fish herself?
faq.answer: Centaur activity leaves Nataka little time to make the journey to the trolls.

faq.q: Where can the Bloodbelly fish be found?
faq.answer: Nataka sends you to Shadowprey Village to speak with its local fisherman, Jinar'Zillen.

faq.q: How do you reach Shadowprey Village from Ghost Walker Post?
aliases: how to get to troll village
faq.answer: The road south from Ghost Walker Post bends west and leads to the troll village.

faq.q: How many Bloodbelly fish does Nataka want?
